privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must upload '/home/ga/Documents/pushup_reference.jpg' to the 'Standard Push-up' exercise. Note: The source file provided in the environment might be an HTML error page disguised as a .jpg; if the wger application (Django/Pillow) rejects it with an 'Upload a valid image' error, the agent has correctly attempted the task but is blocked by a file integrity issue. The license must be set to 'Creative Commons' or 'CC BY-SA'.
